mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use Semantic Versioning (semver) for version numbers, on the reasoning that API compatibility matters far more than publication dates.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md

That comes from decision #25, which replaced the earlier records #22 and #23. I left those out of the file since they were retired. I only ran `muninn show` on the records, so I didn't check the repository for any version scheme the code might already use.

My first attempt to create the file with a shell command failed on a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.
